issues.title: New handling of Transit/Movement orders
issues.body:
For `Transit` orders, there will be a movement event pushed to
adjudication at the end-time for the orders. The recommended outcomes
will be movement outcomes to put all assets at the destination. If
this is an air transit order, and the end point is within 10km (?) of
an airfield then the airfield for those assets will be updated.

For all other orders, if they include a "route back" element, then for
land/maritime orders introduce recommended movement outcomes as above,
but for air orders, do not generate movement outcomes.

For "Strike" orders, where targets are selected (but not geographical
target area), if the target is an airfield, also offer recommended
health (damage) outcomes for air assets assigned to (well, tagged
with) that airfield.
